goal: Implement fare(ages, vehicle) in ferry_fare.py that prices one party's Skelling ferry crossing from age-banded passenger fares and a vehicle fee, with a group waiver, a car carpool reduction, and ValueError for bad ages, unknown vehicles and vehicles without a qualifying passenger.
behaviors: fare([50], "none") returns 7 and fare([2], "none") returns 0 (an adult pays 7, a child under 4 rides free).
fare([10, 80], "none") returns 7 (ages 4 to 15 pay 3 and ages 65 and over pay 4).
fare([25], "van") returns 25 and fare([25], "bike") returns 9 (the vehicle fee is added to the passenger fares).
fare([25, 25, 9, 9], "none") returns 17 and fare([1, 25, 25, 25], "none") returns 21 (with 4 or more paying passengers the single lowest fare is waived; free riders do not count).
fare([25, 40, 1], "car") returns 20 and fare([25, 40, 1], "van") returns 32 (a car with 3 or more passengers of any age pays 6 instead of 12; a van never does).
fare([200], "none"), fare([25], "ship") and fare([12], "van") each raise ValueError.

assumptions.text: ferry_fare.py exists at the repo root as the single flat module.
The tests/ directory exists for the new test file.
pyproject.toml exists so the project toolchain is configured.
pytest can be run through uv without network access.

demo: python -c 'from ferry_fare import fare; print(fare([30, 8], "car")); print(fare([70, 40, 10, 2], "car"))'
out_of_scope: Type checking of arguments (bools, floats, non-list ages)

invariants.text: a fare is at most 7 per passenger plus the largest vehicle fee
